This page plays a partner site written in plain HTML and JavaScript. It embeds the live odds board for Falcons vs Wolves in three ways. Everything below runs against the same Go backend.

Superadmin mode: the board below includes the replay and track-record tools. Use “Interrupt feed” in the Simulator tab to watch the board lock, then recover by itself.

1 · Drop-in script vanilla JS · iframe · auto-height

<div data-oddsboard data-match="match-1" data-market="winner"></div>
<script src="/embed.js" async></script>

el.addEventListener('oddsboard:select', (e) => addToSlip(e.detail));
el.addEventListener('oddsboard:state', (e) => lockSlip(!e.detail.actionable));

Bet slip (host page)

Click a price on the board to add it.

The host still has to re-validate the price with its betting backend.

postMessage events

    2 · Plain iframe HTML only · fixed height

    <iframe src="/embed/match-1/winner?theme=dark" width="100%" height="172" style="border:0"></iframe>

    3 · No iframe vanilla JS · SSE · client.js

    Live odds 
    import { MarketStream, marketUrls } from '/client.js';

const stream = new MarketStream(marketUrls(location.origin, 'match-1', 'winner'));
stream.subscribe((view) => render(view)); // view.actionable gates betting
stream.start();
